note: Huang arXiv:2311.00965 v1 (pdf sha256 52155a5db2c34b9a; published as SPL 213 (2024) 110174, title changed) read 15 Oct 05:4x: Thm 2.1 adjacent edges on any finite connected graph for beta sufficiently large; Thm 2.2 K_n for n large enough and beta sufficiently large or small, all distinct edges. The large-beta proof compares the top two coefficients of the n-th polynomial (spanning trees, then two-tree forests), so the beta thresholds depend on n; no explicit constants. Does not cover every n at every beta. Together with Ciceksiz-Ravichandran 2610.00549 (open for K_n in full generality) and Gupta 2609.26134 (beta=1 only), C015-C018 (reviewer PASS) would be the first all-n all-beta K_n statement known to us; priority still subject to the published SPL text, which was not read.

history.note: 15 Oct 05:3x agent P: equal-weight forests on K_n at EVERY lambda>0 and every n are stated OPEN by both newest papers. Ciceksiz-Ravichandran 2610.00549: Kahn's Conjecture 1.2 'remains open even for complete graphs in full generality'; they have Stark for n>=n_0(lambda), lambda>C_G (large fugacity), and the q<1 random-cluster model on K_n for weights >=1 (Thm 5.6 / Cor 1.10), not the forest at small lambda. Gupta 2609.26134: lambda=1 (beta=1) only, every n; cites Huang [6] (Statist. Probab. Lett. 213 (2024) 110174) for small- and large-beta regimes on K_n, thresholds not read (paywalled, not on arXiv). So worker T C018 (all t>0, all n, strict for n>=3), if it survives the worker S second audit, settles the K_n case of Kahn's conjecture at all equal weights. Read Huang's thresholds before any priority sentence.
